visual_elements.description: Scatter plot of iris dataset projected onto two components. X-axis labeled Z₁ (red italic), ticks at -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. Y-axis labeled Z₂ (red italic), ticks at -1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5. Three clusters: orange/red points (Setosa) clustered around x≈-2.7, y≈0.2 inside a vertical yellow ellipse spanning roughly x -3.4 to -2.0, y -1.1 to 1.5; green points (Versicolor) centered around x≈1.0, y≈0.0; blue points (Virginica) centered around x≈2.2, y≈0.3. A large light-blue ellipse encloses the green+blue points, tilted positively, spanning roughly x -1.2 to 4.2, y -1.3 to 1.5. A small cursor arrow is visible near (3.0, 0.6).
Thin dark-red rectangular border framing the plot and legend area; a matching red border also frames the entire slide edge.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8). 2. Draw a thin dark-red (#8B0000) rectangle border inset slightly from the slide edges, and a second red rectangle framing the central content region (approx x 25-78%, y 17-90%). 3. Insert a scatter plot in the center: x-axis Z₁ (red italic, subscript 1) with ticks -3 to 4; y-axis Z₂ (red italic, subscript 2) with ticks -1.0 to 1.5 in 0.5 steps. 4. Plot three clusters: orange (#E8720C) points around (-2.7, 0.2); green (#3D9970) around (1.0, 0.0); blue (#2E2EB8) around (2.2, 0.3). 5. Add a vertical yellow (#F5E625, semi-transparent) ellipse around the orange cluster and a large tilted light-blue (#A9C6E8, semi-transparent) ellipse enclosing the green and blue clusters. 6. Place legend at right of plot: 'Setosa' in red, 'Versicolor' in green, 'Virginica' in blue, stacked vertically. 7. Add yellow circle badge with '38' at top-right corner. 8. Optionally add a small cursor arrow near coordinate (3.0, 0.6).
